details: The US Senate has blocked the Digital Asset Market Clarity Act (CLARITY Act) from advancing, with a 50-49 vote falling short of the 60 votes required for passage. This legislative setback leaves the regulatory framework for digital assets in the United States without clear guidelines, contributing to a period of increased uncertainty and caution among cryptocurrency investors. The failed vote has prompted traders to reduce their exposure to riskier assets, impacting overall market sentiment.
title: US Senate Blocks CLARITY Act, Increasing Crypto Regulatory Uncertainty

details: The US Federal Reserve has raised interest rates by 25 basis points, pushing the target range to 3.75% to 4%. This move signifies a tightening of monetary policy, which typically leads to reduced liquidity in financial markets and makes traditional, yield-bearing investments more appealing to investors. The rate hike contributes to bearish sentiment for cryptocurrencies and other risk assets, as investors become more cautious in an environment of higher borrowing costs.
title: Federal Reserve Hikes Rates by 25 BPS, Pressuring Crypto Markets
